name: Ask Platform Guide
description: The Slack front door (ADR 0081 decision 6): asks platform-guide what a workflow on this Platform does or what one of its jobs did, in the Platform's own agent session, and puts the answer on a Work Center card the bot reads back into the thread. The agent has one read-only tool, Describe for an Agent; nothing is changed
